name: nablamath-site
description: Site estático com estado verificável do NablaMath

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/data',{recursive:true}); for (const f of ['index.html','styles.css','app.js','worker.js']) fs.copyFileSync(f,path.join('dist',f)); fs.copyFileSync('data/status.json','dist/data/status.json')"
